data.body:
Landed as Gerrit 1376 / commit 42076d367e ("store: absorb local git lock contention (9305)"),
MERGED (LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1 on PS4) and reachable from origin/main. AC verification:

AC1 — OSS research findings recorded: 8 research-bearing comments on this ticket; the Approach
  cites them. ✓
AC2 — transient index.lock/ref-lock self-heals: covered by the contention suite (behavioral (a)
  + ref-lock test). ✓
AC3 — permanently held lock -> one actionable error naming the lock file + remedy, bounded
  jittered budget: behavioral test (b). ✓
AC4 — uncontended writes add no latency (no happy-path sleep): behavioral test (c). This was the
  PS3 flake (stdlib subprocess internal sleep mis-counted); fixed in PS4 via the gitutil
  _backoff_sleep seam so the test measures only rebar's deliberate backoff. ✓
AC5 — every local git call site bounded-with-watchdog or documented-unbounded, incl. BOTH fsck
  sites (fsck.py:50 and :400, each annotated "Watchdog, not a latency budget (9305)"). ✓
AC6 — blocking policy stated in gitutil.py module docstring (bounded jittered retry + advisory
  serialization; silent transient recovery; one actionable error on a stuck lock). ✓
AC7 — make lint / make typecheck / targeted tests exit zero: green in CI (Verified +1) and
  re-run locally now — tests/interfaces/store/test_git_contention_9305.py -> 9 passed. ✓
Verdict: all ACs satisfied. Closing.
